notes: Belt-drive opener with Wi-Fi and battery backup. The model is shown as discontinued.

gaps: It does not say which numbers the opener shipped with.

Part numbers conflict with the manual: motor with travel module DC 041-0236-000 (manual: 041D8006-1); logic board, Bluetooth enabled 050DCTBFMC (manual: receiver logic board 050DCTWF); safety sensor kit 041-0136 for 2021 to present (manual: 41A5034).
Motor voltage is not stated anywhere read.
So fn motor_dc_small is an editorial call from the word DC.
The manual does not state the battery chemistry.
The battery_pb tag rests on that retailer description.
The manual gives no radio frequency (it says MyQ and Security+ 2.0 compatible and that MyQ needs 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi).
No FCC ID tied to this model was found.
The light socket appears twice in the exploded view but the table gives no quantity.
method: Main source: owner's manual 114A5036 (copyright 2017, The Chamberlain Group), a copy on Home Depot's image server; read as text, repair-parts pages 43-44 also checked as rendered images (battery backup p. 31).
Second source: Chamberlain's own B970 product page.
Its list is of currently available replacement parts.
It names the transformer 'Transformer, Wi-Fi B battery backup' with the same 041D0277-1 number.
The manual only says the battery supplies 12 Vdc to the opener.
A garage-door parts retailer page lists 41A6357-1 among the other numbers for LiftMaster 485LM, which it calls a 12 V DC sealed lead battery.
The fccid.io exhibit pages show a security check, and apps.fcc.gov returned an error.

comps.spec: Motor with travel module, DC; current replacement part 041-0236-000 on Chamberlain's B970 replacement-parts list

Receiver logic board 050DCTWF, with its own end panel 041D8214 (end panel for receiver logic board, with light socket); the opener is MyQ and Security+ 2.0 compatible, and MyQ setup needs 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi
Safety sensor kit 41A5034: sending sensor (amber LED) and receiving sensor (green LED) with wire; brackets 041A5266-3
Light socket 041C0279 behind lens 041D7572; takes incandescent bulbs up to 100 W or CFL up to 26 W; manual advises against LED bulbs (may cut remote range)
Backup battery, replacement part 41A6357-1; supplies 12 Vdc to the opener; about 24 h to charge fully, 1-2 days of normal use in an outage, lasts roughly 1-2 years
Belt 041A5250, idler pulley 144C54, master link 4A1008; motor-end sprocket and cover with screws 041C1751
Travel module 041D8071-4; the motor is also listed with it as 'motor with travel module' 041D8006-1, and the troubleshooting chart points to the travel module when door travel can't be set or kept
Line cord 041B4245-1, plus wire harness 041D8255 and terminal block 041A3150
